Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows mild leukopenia, anemia, thrombocytopenia, increased red cell distribution width, and low total protein, suggesting possible chronic disease, nutritional deficiency, or bone marrow dysfunction. There is also relative neutropenia, lymphopenia, and basophilia. Liver and kidney function, electrolytes, and glucose are within normal limits. Clinical correlation and further evaluation for underlying causes (e.g., hematologic, nutritional, or chronic inflammatory conditions) are recommended.
